let's also use uv instead of curl install. also, can we add these to the html?

Show stats for percentage of operations for each agent, each person

content.text: Two changes: a `pyproject.toml` so `uv tool install` works from the repo (replacing the curl/install.sh route), and per-actor stats back in the viz — black-and-white text this time. Starting with packaging:

input.command:
which uv; cat > /Users/bmo/sun/pyproject.toml <<'EOF'
[project]
name = "sun"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "An operation log for humans + agents on top of git"
requires-python = ">=3.9"

[project.scripts]
sun = "sun:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["flit_core>=3.2,<4"]
build-backend = "flit_core.buildapi"
EOF
git rm -q install.sh && uv build 2>&1 | tail -2 && python3 -m zipfile -l dist/sun-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl | head -4
input.description: Add pyproject, drop install.sh, test uv build
